content.summary: The inspected I7, B4 and high-link imports have the stated source scope. A bounded reconstruction matched the I7 catalogue and mixed-trace table, and the cited replay files matched the pinned source. No required revision arose. This does not certify all later models or finite leaves.

findings.statement: The finite I7 catalogue is supported by both its cited source and this bounded reconstruction, while applicability to arbitrary support rests on the separately stated geometric reduction.
findings.disposition: The manuscript and source map preserve that distinction. The wrapper's later global-use gate does not enter check_seven.verify or the preceding universal support argument. No complete R16 tree replay, solver or Lean job was run.

revisions.action: Followed I7/B4/high-link pointers into the pinned manuscript, catalogue checker, certificate and saved normal/optimized outputs.
revisions.result: The inspected locations and import boundaries match. Bounded catalogue reconstruction strengthens this particular check without upgrading the entire proof's assurance.

revisions.action: Rechecked the distinction between universal I7 classification, rho-guarded R16 classification and support separation in high links.
revisions.result: The relevant guards remain explicit; there are no earlier required revisions outstanding for this reviewer.

checks.scope: I7 arbitrary-support reduction before finite enumeration
checks.method: Read pinned paper/main.tex lines465-529 and D17-I7-classification-route.md, especially the reconstructed support argument; checked the degree-count integer constraints independently.
checks.observation: Degree6 is excluded by the two-triangle cover obstruction; degree5 gives six-point C5 or the seven-point triangle-plus-path case. Degree1 gives the listed (3,3,0)/(3,2,1) alternatives. With degrees2-4, 2b+3c+4d=21 and 2d>=2b+c admit support at most6; direct bounded enumeration confirms no support7 tuple. Thus the finite six-point domain plus H7 follows from an ordinary universal reduction, not an ambient cutoff or an R16 embedding assumption.

checks.scope: I7 finite catalogue and arbitrary-exterior mixed-trace claims
checks.method: Wrote and executed a bounded standard-library bitmask reconstruction from the eight literal templates, without importing repository code: complementary-pair selections, equal-intersection tests, S6 orbits and all size1/2 traces.
checks.observation: All15360 selections yielded1860 valid families. Orbit sizes were120,360,60,240,360,360,360; their disjoint union equalled the valid set. All175 mixed traces matched the source table, and H7 was directly intersecting and sunflower-free. A forbidden trace has an actual-pair equal-intersection witness; adding exterior points changes none of those intersections. This checks that finite interface, not every downstream joint-realizability claim.

checks.method: Read pinned paper/main.tex proposition prop:i810, lemmas lem:isolation and lem:b4 at lines227-330, and lem:r16maximal at lines612-635; compared manuscript section3 and the source map.
checks.observation: B4 requires an actual triple with at least eight disjoint members. The disjoint class is intersecting; isolation excludes deleted P-blocks or exceptional Q8 hub-leaf triples from the complementary class because they would belong to the disjoint class. Q8 leaves remain shareable. In sizes17-20 every listed split contains a P9 or P10 component, so P-type isolation supplies disjoint supports. The source does not impose that stronger separation on lower-degree Q8/Q8 partitions.

checks.scope: Citation pin, actual selected replay and wrapper scope
checks.method: Confirmed assignment hashes and prior HEAD; byte-compared main.tex and five R16 checker/certificate files against Git HEAD, the five computational files against the replayed package, and both saved R16 stdout hashes against the October20 receipt. Read verify.py and check_seven.py.
checks.observation: Both assignment hashes match. HEAD is90c03c79bcf44eb8f61dff1b86091b822cc4cd3c; all six HEAD comparisons, five package comparisons and two stdout commitments match. The package excludes main.tex, which was checked directly against Git. Both outputs contain the cited1860/15360/175 counts. check_seven.verify receives the catalogue alone; the wrapper's global_gate is reported metadata, not a premise of its universal I7 enumeration. Reusing those outputs is accurately described as selected prior replay, not all42 suites or independent human validation.
